body: The drama continues as RaKai speaks out after the allegations Reggie made against him and the Clover Boys started circulating. In his response, RaKai didn’t hold back, making it clear that he strongly denies the claims and believes Reggie’s statements are completely false. “Everything Reggie said was a f*cking lie…” RaKai also shared that he hopes Reggie gets better, but stood firm in his denial, insisting that he didn’t do anything to him. Is Rakai telling the truth?
